champion.scope: Predicts channel, committed_count, or committed_sum for a fresh action sequence by simulating all 18 family members and keeping those consistent with calibration receipts.
champion.lesson: The receipts show put on an existing key yields channel 1 and committed_sum equal to the new value, which rules out INSERT OR IGNORE (would give channel 0 and old value) and is consistent with REPLACE or upsert; the trigger and channel variants are disambiguated by simulating each candidate against all receipts and intersecting predictions.
